dataset.task: single-file commit message -> matching changed file-version
dataset.automated_labels: same commit SHA and changed source file. No human relevance annotation.

limitations: Commits and qrels extracted from one repository, not general RAG questions.
Index sizes exclude source storage and shared normalization model; vocabulary is reported separately.
A full baseline using changed regions with BM25, hybrid neural reranker, and real end-to-end RAG not available here.
Target revision is a single changed file, and commit messages may not mention changed terms.
Deleted content can appear in the special diff channel, which is useful for historical change search but may mislead current-state QA.
